translations.web: The Lord Yahweh says: “I will spread out my net on you with a company of many peoples; and they will bring you up in my net.
translations.bsb: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I will spread My net over you with a company of many peoples, and they will draw you up in My net.
translations.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will therefore spread out my net over thee with a company of many people; and they shall bring thee up in my net.
translations.asv: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will spread out my net upon thee with a company of many peoples; and they shall bring thee up in my net.
